title: Label on the first submessage, and fields the standard does not define

source.note: composed: §5.2.1 gives Label to submessages and §5.1 does not list it for the first submessage; it is accepted there rather than refused, since it carries the same meaning. Fields the standard does not define are ignored — nothing in §5 forbids them, and an end-point that refused them could not talk to a newer peer.

notes: canonical_json drops the undefined fields: re-encoding is not a round-trip of the document, only of the model.
